Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Sections 420, 465, 466, 468, 471, 474, 120B, Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 8 and Section 9 of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 in connection with the Case Crime No.32 of 2017, registered at police station Pantnagar, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 8 and Section 9
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard Mr. Shariq Khurshid, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Suresh Chandra Dumka,
learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.
Mr. Shariq Khurshid, Advocate submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present matter.
He was not arrested during the course of the investigation.
Charge-sheet has already been filed, therefore, there is no requirement of custodial interrogation of the applicant.
Co-accused persons have been granted interim anticipatory bail by this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the State has sought two weeks' time to file objection(s) to the Anticipatory Bail Application.

5. List along with ABA No.802 of 2023.
6.
